title: The site emails the Founder itself: the daily batch, decisions and the session manager's messages
why: Jason, 2026-11-25: "If I have to allow emails in claude that's a problem. Can you use the system for emailing?" The site's own Notify (decisions/0172, 0176: Pulse first, the system's own email, free under CLAUDE.md's No income, no expense) now emails the Founder, and only the Founder (CommsSetup::founders), three things, each once: today's daily batch (decisions/0179 rule 1; P2-5's gauges.json "batch"), one email per date on the thread batch:<date>; a Tier 3 decision reaching "Waiting for you" (GaugeTasks::sendBrief), its brief on the thread task:<id>; and the session manager's messages (releases/batch.json's new "messages", carried by gauges.py), each by its id. What was sent is kept in founder_mail_sent, so nothing goes twice. Never from staging. A Tier 2 release (Jason's ruling, 0179's note "Tier 2 publishes on its own once Piece 3 is live"); it adds one table and changes nothing that exists. Also (the session manager, 2026-11-26, a gap in P2-5's own purpose, no decision changed): the Work queue's batch strip and this email show the latest batch until it's approved or a newer one replaces it, not only on its UTC date (ControlGauges::latestBatch). A batch merged late in the UTC day, with the site's hour-long cache of gauges.json, was never shown at all, and the Founder has to see it to approve it. Approved by Jason with the 2026-11-26 batch (it counts as Approve notify).

changes.what: The batch strip: the latest batch shown as "The latest batch" until it's approved, not only on its UTC date
Today's batch emailed to the Founder once a day it's written, with each release, its checks, its way back and the Work queue's link
A Tier 3 decision emailed with its brief when it reaches Waiting for you
The session manager's messages emailed, each once
The job founder_mail_tick (every 10 minutes, live only) on Scheduled tasks
FAQ: How does the Founder hear about the daily batch and decisions?

checks.founder_only_once: tools/notify-founder-tests/founder.php, 17 checks on MariaDB: today's batch once to the Founder alone (not staff, not an ended login), yesterday's unapproved batch once and not once approved, a future-dated one never, each message id once and bad ones skipped, a decision once when sendBrief moves it to Waiting, a Work ticket never, nothing on staging, no Founder means nothing marked sent, the three kinds in Notify, the job live-only and quiet. A copy with the once and staging guards taken out fails 5 of them.
